I wrote the solution in `main.wj`, and it compiles and runs under `wj run --compiled`.

I piped in the examples from the task plus `255 10 16`. The output was `10`, `10100001111`, `0` and `FF`, which matches the expected results.

I did not test the upper limit of 2^63 - 1, or any input with blank or malformed lines. The code skips lines with fewer than three fields. The build prints an unused-imp
